comment: Three things the maker's own configuration gets wrong. The ENV output is configured as 'Square' at loom.cpp:620, but loom.cpp:732 writes the ping envelope to it and the manual documents it as the envelope. The pivot attenuverter is configured as 'Spectral Shaping Intensity CV Attenuverter' at loom.cpp:585, but loom.cpp:705 uses it on the S PIVOT input; the intensity input has no attenuverter at all. And the DRIVE input, index 4, was never given a configInput call, so it has no tooltip. The panel prints OFF, SYNC and ON for the continuous stride switch while the switch is configured Off, Sync and Free. The BLEP menu's names are offset from the level they set: the default is level 3, which is the item printed '2nd Order', while the manual recommends '3rd Order'. The manual says the Nyquist falloff starts at 0.75 of Nyquist; loom.cpp:294 puts the fade's lower bound at two thirds of the harmonic multiple limit. The FM input is coloured as CV rather than pitch: in EXP mode at full attenuverter it does track a volt per octave, but it passes through an attenuverter that starts at zero and a switch that makes it linear, so it is not a jack a keyboard is patched into.
